section.title: First Dark Festival Signals
section.subtitle: Curated, source-aware signals from goth, darkwave, post-punk, industrial, and dark alternative festivals across North America.
section.trust_note: Official and organizer-controlled sources are prioritized. Confirmed, date-pending, and regional records are labeled before they expand into the atlas.
section.clarification_note: Signal cards mix active atlas entries with tracked festival leads. Some items are fully listed in the atlas, while others are reference or future-edition signals we’re monitoring until official dates, locations, or source confidence are stronger.
section.closing_microcopy: More North America signals are being verified. The atlas expands only as sources hold.

signals.name: Darker Waves
signals.cultural_hook: Beach darkness and new-wave memory on the Southern California coast.
signals.art_direction: Coastal ultraviolet haze: a soft ocean-night signal with muted violet, indigo, and restrained cyan edge light.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Southern California beach darkness: new-wave memory, post-punk atmosphere, and synth nostalgia in a coastal frame.
signals.why_this_matters: It gives the atlas an immediate West Coast gateway where familiar retro-alt sounds can lead visitors toward deeper darkwave and post-punk discovery.
signals.seasonal_relevance: Fall-facing atmosphere; useful for colder-night dark festival framing without naming dates.
signals.scene_relationships: Post-punk, darkwave, synthpop/new wave nostalgia, and broader retro alternative audiences. Pairs naturally with Cruel World as a Southern California gateway, while feeling more darkwave/post-punk specific.
signals.source_confidence_notes: High confidence for public homepage inclusion. Official source tracked. Avoid lineup, date, venue, ticket, or travel claims unless separately refreshed during implementation.

signals.name: Dark Force Fest
signals.cultural_hook: A Northeast dark weekend reference where goth, industrial, and darkwave scenes converge.
signals.source_cue: Official source tracked; future edition not confirmed
signals.art_direction: Castle-night violet shadow: denser East Coast gothic atmosphere with deep purple-black gradients and minimal cyan glints.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Northeast goth/industrial gathering with strong destination identity and a darker weekend atmosphere.
signals.why_this_matters: It gives the first packet a clear East Coast / Mid-Atlantic anchor for visitors entering through goth, industrial, deathrock, and darkwave overlap.
signals.seasonal_relevance: Reference-only dark weekend signal; do not imply active dates until a future official edition appears.
signals.scene_relationships: Strong goth and industrial crossover, with darkwave, post-punk, deathrock, dark alternative, and club-culture adjacency. Useful counterpart to Cold Waves.
signals.source_confidence_notes: High confidence for past/source context, but not active/upcoming-safe. Keep as homepage signal/reference only; do not present as an active atlas record.

signals.name: Cold Waves
signals.cultural_hook: Chicago industrial gravity for listeners drawn to cold electronics and post-industrial sound.
signals.art_direction: Steel-blue industrial grid: colder blue-black structure, low violet haze, and a controlled mechanical texture.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Chicago industrial/dark electronic anchor with cold synth atmosphere and post-industrial lineage.
signals.why_this_matters: It shows RetroAltFest is not only goth/darkwave by name; the atlas understands the industrial, EBM, and dark electronic currents that shape North American dark scenes.
signals.seasonal_relevance: Fall-facing emotional fit; useful for Chicago / Great Lakes industrial-axis storytelling without asserting dates.
signals.scene_relationships: Industrial, EBM, dark electronic, post-industrial, and coldwave-adjacent. Connects well to Dark Force Fest for industrial/goth crossover.
signals.source_confidence_notes: High confidence for homepage inclusion. Official source tracked. Normalize main festival identity separately from broader Cold Waves Presents activity.

signals.name: Verboden Music Festival
signals.cultural_hook: A fog-lined Pacific Northwest corridor to watch for darkwave, post-punk, and minimal synth discovery.
signals.source_cue: Official source tracked; future edition needs refresh
signals.art_direction: PNW fog corridor: misted indigo, cyan-violet restraint, and soft regional ambiguity rather than a single pin.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Pacific Northwest / Vancouver corridor signal for darkwave, post-punk, minimal wave, synth, and underground electronic culture.
signals.why_this_matters: It proves the atlas can handle corridors, not just single pins: a source-aware route concept for cross-border dark-scene discovery.
signals.seasonal_relevance: Corridor language is useful, but keep the card date-neutral and do not imply an active upcoming edition.
signals.scene_relationships: Darkwave, post-punk, coldwave, minimal wave, synth, and underground electronic. Connects Southern California post-punk/darkwave gateways to Canada / cross-border signals.
signals.source_confidence_notes: Strong fit and source trail, but blocked from app data until future-edition and parent/child city modeling are resolved. Do not imply one exact venue or pin.

signals.name: Absolution Fest
signals.cultural_hook: A Southeast gothic outpost for deathrock, post-punk, darkwave, and warm-night scene discovery.
signals.art_direction: Warm-night magenta shadow: humid Southeast nocturne, muted violet-black depth, and restrained red/magenta undertones.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Southeast goth/deathrock/post-punk signal with warm-night atmosphere and niche-scene identity.
signals.why_this_matters: It keeps the first packet from over-centering the West Coast, Northeast, and Chicago, giving the South / Southeast a visible but carefully labeled dark-scene foothold.
signals.seasonal_relevance: Confirmed upcoming signal; avoid over-specific venue or schedule language unless refreshed from official sources.
signals.scene_relationships: Goth, deathrock, post-punk, darkwave, and dark alternative. Connects to Dark Force Fest through goth/deathrock energy and to Darker Waves / Verboden through post-punk and darkwave adjacency.
signals.source_confidence_notes: High public source confidence after app-data integration planning. Official source tracked; keep venue/map wording cautious.

signals.name: Cruel World
signals.cultural_hook: A recognizable Southern California gateway into new wave, post-punk, and goth-adjacent memory.
signals.source_cue: Official source tracked; future edition not confirmed
signals.art_direction: Pasadena / LA retro-alt sunset noir: muted amber-magenta shadow, black-violet gradient, and legacy alternative glow.
signals.editorial_descriptor: Larger Southern California retro-alt gateway where new wave, post-punk, goth-adjacent, and legacy alternative audiences overlap.
signals.why_this_matters: It helps adjacent visitors enter the atlas through a recognizable cultural doorway, then move toward more scene-specific signals like Darker Waves, Verboden, Absolution, or Cold Waves.
signals.pathway_concept: Go deeper than the obvious festival
signals.seasonal_relevance: Reference-only gateway framing. Do not suggest current season timing unless a fresh official source check confirms a future edition.
signals.scene_relationships: New wave, post-punk, goth-adjacent, synthpop, retro alternative, and legacy alternative. Strongly paired with Darker Waves as a Southern California gateway, but positioned as broader and more mainstream-adjacent.
signals.source_confidence_notes: High confidence for official source and cultural relevance, but not active/upcoming-safe. Use careful reference labeling only.
